source.question: F-12's water cut is near 0.97 and its oil rate has fallen below 200 Sm3/d. What would you recommend doing to the well, and why?

note: Reviewed Oct 29, fair: '3210' given the plug job's first day (2010-09-20) where the cited report sets it on 2010-09-23 (production_log now dates a plug by the report naming it), details from results it does not cite.

submission.summary: F-12 makes almost all water with about 97% water cut and only about 175 Sm3/d of oil, its downhole gauge has been dead since 2010, and a water shut-off plug set in 2010 made things worse. The fit suggests the next 12 months will make about 49,600 Sm3, range 20,600 to 60,500 Sm3, and the WOR trend shows no recoverable oil left to 95% water cut. Do not set another plug now — run a new production log first to confirm where water enters, as the last log is 1,500 days old.

findings.claim: F-12's water cut is about 97% and its oil rate is about 175 Sm3/d as of 2014-10-31, with a dead downhole gauge for 1,408 days.
findings.detail: field_screen 90-day window as_of 2014-10-31: oil_rate_sm3_per_day 174.6, water_cut 0.9669, uptime 0.9149; gauge_failure since 2010-10-12 1408 days 880456 Sm3 produced without pressure data; production_monthly 2014-10 water_cut 0.9665 oil_rate_per_producing_day 173.5.

findings.claim: A bridge plug set at 3,210 m on 2010-09-20 did not help: water cut rose from 64% to 68% in the next 60 days.
findings.detail: production_log plugs_set date 2010-09-20 depth_m 3210; before_60_days water_cut 0.638 oil_sm3_per_day 1850 days 48, after_60_days water_cut 0.676 oil_sm3_per_day 1612 days 59; well_operations 2010-09-23 installed plug at 3210 m in blank pipe 3180-3220 m.

findings.claim: On the 2010-09 log a plug at 3,210 m would have removed about 33% of the water and about 1% of the oil.
findings.detail: production_log PLT 2010-09 low rate below 3210 oil_share 0.011 water_share 0.325, medium rate oil_share 0.015 water_share 0.376; perforated zones 3131-3147, 3161-3180, 3220-3231, 3236-3243, 3250-3257, blank_pipe 3180-3220; since_survey days 1500 water_cut_then 0.6307 water_cut_now 0.9658.

findings.claim: Water takes the well's capacity: liquid held at 5,136 Sm3/d with choke at 100% in 2014 while the WOR trend leaves no oil to 95% water cut.
findings.detail: waterflood by_year 2014 liquid_rate 5136 choke 100.0 water_cut 0.9635 vs 2013 liquid 5096 choke 99.61 water_cut 0.9044; wor_fit r2 0.8799 log10_wor_per_million 2.05, WOR now 28.85 above 19.0 limit for 95% cut, remaining_oil 0.0 at 80/90/95% cuts.

findings.claim: The next 12 months forecast is about 49,600 Sm3 central estimate, range 20,600 to 60,500 Sm3 calibrated band.
findings.detail: forecast_production exponential fit window 2008-02-13 to 2014-10-31 n 2127 r2_log 0.9186 qi 7122 di_per_year 0.53 b 0.0; cumulative p50 49592 calibrated_band p90 20634 p10 60532 past_forecasts 21 coverage 0.82; p50_by_model exponential 49592 hyperbolic 49681.

result.levels: alarm: act now; caution: watch; note: for the record

result.summary: 30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.05 on 2009-10-31, 21 months after first oil.
water_cut shifts around 2010-03-28: weekly mean 0.043 -> 0.689 (+0.65) from the period before to the period after.
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.5 on 2010-06-04, 28 months after first oil.

oil_rate shifts around 2010-07-18: weekly mean 4,050 -> 1,307 (-68%) from the period before to the period after; across the change itself, 4 weeks each side, 2,352 -> 1,838 (-22%); the choke stayed about the same (54 -> 51%).
Shut in for 12 days from 2010-08-16. Oil rate 1,821 -> 2,000 Sm3/d (+10%) after restart. Same time as F-14.

bhp_bar reads 0 on 1408 days from 2010-10-12 to 2014-10-31 while the well kept flowing on 1229 days (880,456 Sm3 oil): a sensor failure, not a pressure collapse. Last good reading: 253.9 on 2010-10-11.
Shut in for 10 days from 2011-06-21. Oil rate 1,144 -> 1,364 Sm3/d (+19%) after restart. Same time as F-14.
Shut in for 20 days from 2011-10-16. Oil rate 955 -> 1,158 Sm3/d (+21%) after restart. Same time as F-14.
Shut in for 11 days from 2012-01-03. Oil rate 1,063 -> 1,028 Sm3/d (-3%) after restart. Same time as F-14.
water_cut shifts around 2012-02-12: weekly mean 0.689 -> 0.912 (+0.22) from the period before to the period after.
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.8 on 2012-02-14, 48 months after first oil.

oil_rate shifts around 2012-03-11: weekly mean 1,307 -> 625 (-52%) from the period before to the period after; across the change itself, 4 weeks each side, 931 -> 864 (-7%); the choke stayed about the same (100 -> 97%).
Shut in for 46 days from 2012-08-14. Oil rate 691 -> 728 Sm3/d (+5%) after restart. Same time as F-14.
Shut in for 13 days from 2013-03-12. Oil rate 531 -> 572 Sm3/d (+8%) after restart.

oil_rate shifts around 2013-09-15: weekly mean 625 -> 228 (-63%) from the period before to the period after; across the change itself, 4 weeks each side, 521 -> 356 (-32%); the choke was cut at the same time (100 -> 87%), so part of the change is the operator's, not the reservoir's.
Shut in for 9 days from 2014-05-16. Oil rate 194 -> 193 Sm3/d (-1%) after restart.

result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.

summaries.summary: Skidded rig to F-12. Made up 36" hole opener BHA and RIH with same to 85 m MD.
Made FG check of TDS. Serviced TDS. RIH with 36" hole opener. Drilled 36" hole section from 145 m to 250 m MD.

Drilled 36" hole section to TD at 258 m MD. Displaced well to 1,40 sg mud. POOH with 36" hole opener BHA. Rigged up for running 30" conductor. Ran 30" conductor. Started running 4 3/4" cement stinger inside conductor.
Dismounted and mounted tension cylinders. RIH with production riser to 100 m MD.

RIH with PR tensioner joint. MU PR landing stand, RIH and landed riser. Locked TBC connector. Waited on Simens rig ESD test. Pressure tested PR to 200 bar. Install centralizer and boat collision stool on centralizer deck.
MU tensioner ring assembly. POOH and LD PR RT. Installed hatch on F-12 and suspended operation to F-7.
Skidded rig from F-12 to F-15. Changed wire on port aft crane big hook.
Built scaffolding at the well head deck and in the moon pool. Installed surface riser, BOP and tension cylinders.
Nippled up slick jnt, diverter and torqued up the BOP. RIH and installed the Bowl Protector at 20.9 m. Retrieved the Annulus Insert at 139.9 m. Retrieved the Bowl Protector.
RIH with 10 3/4" Tie Back and made up into sub sea well. Pressure tested Tie Back connector to 345 bars. Attempted to lock the Surface hanger, with the Adjustment sub.
Retrieved landing string. Installed BPV. Nippled down BOP and Riser. Installed dart in BPV. Terminated control lines. Installed extension spool.
Installed the WH extension spool, Xmas tree and the production Co-flex hose.
Leak tested X-mas tree connections to 30/345 bars 5/10 min. Lined up and leak tested production line 50/180 bars 5/10 min. Inflow tested LMV and HMV against BPV.
Sent firing command to E-Fire firing head in TCP guns and perforated well from 3130 to 3281 mMDRT.

Handed well over from Production. RU HMV and DHSV to local control panel. Installed test and bleed manifold on to XMT KWV. Performed line test from KWV to cmt unit. Attempted to leak tested XMT cross to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min.

Operated and greased up leaking PWV. Leak tested XMT cross to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min. Installed WL BOP and riser on XMT. Tested shear seals on WL BOP. Installed combination toolstring in riser. MU lubricator. Leak test WL riser, BOP and lubricator. Equalize and open HMV and DHSV. RIH with combination toolstring and tagged TCP guns at 3260.5 m. Performed correlation log in 7" liner. POOH and prepared for inflow test of HMV.

Inflow tested HMV to 81-5 bar/10 min. Broke lubricator and LD toolstring. Installed PLT toolstring in riser. MU lubricator and leak tested at in-situ sub. Equalized and opened HMV. RIH with PLT toolstring on 7/16" EWL from surface to 2929 m. Performed stationary logging at DHPG depth. Continued RIH from 2929 m to 3030 m to perform shut-in station logs and 4 PLT tool calibration passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Bean up well to 4500 Sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 high rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Choked back flow to 3000 Sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 medium rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD.

Choked back flow to 1500 Sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 low rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Shut-in well. POOH with PLT toolstring. Inflow tested DHSV, HMV and MMV for handover. BO lubricator and LD toolstring. LD lubricator. RD and LD WL riser.

RD BOP from XMT. Leak test XMT cross, KWV and tree cap. Hand well over to Mærsk Production. Cleared and cleaned rig floor of remaining WL equipment. Transferred operation to F-99 for PRS-and 5-yearly BOP classification.
Waited on access to well. Took over well. Rigged up WL riser and BOP.

RU WL equipment. Installed BHA into lubricator. RIH with PLT. Performed spinner calibration. Performed depth correlation with GR/CCL. Took stationary reading at 2929 m. Ran PLT shut in pass. Took stationary readings. Beaned up well. Waited for stable flow.

Waited for stable flow aprox. 5050 Sm3/d with PLT at 3080 m. Attempted to RIH at various speed. No-go. Reduced flow rate to 3000 Sm3/d. Took stationary readings at 3080, 3155, 3200 and 3250 m. Logged flowing passes between 3030 and 3250 m, down at 40 m/min and up at 10/20/30/40 m/min. Reduced flow rate to 1500 Sm3/d. Logged flowing passes between 3000 and 3250 m, down at 40 m/min and up at 10/20/30/40 m/min. Unable to log down on both flowing rates at 10/20/30 m/min. POOH with PLT. Changed tool string. RIH with 5,72" EVO bridge plug at 800 m.
Installed 5,72" EVO bridge plug at 3210 m mid element. RD wireline pressure control equipment and handed well over to production department.

result.note: Daily reports exist for drilling and for work on the well (wireline, plugs, perforations, production logs), not for days of normal production. A job's date is the day the work was done; kind is drilling, completion, workover (work on a producing or injecting well) or abandonment. Ask for one day to see every operation line.

surveys.read_from: LAS files of the interpreted log (Well_logs_pr_WELL/15_9-F-12/10.PRODUCTION LOGS/PLT Sept 2010)

result.note: A production log measures the flow passing each depth while the well flows; going up, it grows past each zone that produces. A share at a depth is the part of the pass's oil or water entering below that depth (1 at the bottom of the well's inflow, 0 above the top zone). comes_in_from_m to to_m holds 90% of each phase's inflow. Only shares are given: the files' rates have no units, and the plots' are downhole volumes. A plug set at a depth shuts off what enters below it: the shares below say what it could remove, not what it did; plugs_set gives what each plug already set did to the well (water cut and oil before and after). A bridge plug is set in blank pipe, never inside a perforated interval (inside_perforation_m names the interval a depth falls in; blank_pipe_m lists the gaps). since_survey says how old the latest log is and how far the water cut has moved since: an old log may no longer show where the water enters, and a new one would settle it. Each survey's passes were run at several surface rates. A survey read off pictures carries the checks of that reading.

result.calibrated_band_note: P90-P10 from the errors of 21 forecasts made the same way from earlier dates on data up to then; use it for confidence, the bootstrap band above only reflects the fit's scatter. With 21 past forecasts such a range holds about 82% of outcomes.
result.p50_by_model_note: The P50 each Arps model gives on this window: when they differ widely, the choice of model drives the forecast as much as the data does.
result.note: P90 = low case, P10 = high case. Volumes = rate x historical uptime.

result.scope: whole field, all producers and injectors summed per day, then per month
result.plan_source: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation), page 23, Table 4.3

water_sm3_per_day.limit: field water handling (derived: liquid capacity x maximum water cut)

result.plan_end_quote: Kumulativ oljeproduksjon inntil minimum økonomisk rate på 2.100 Sm3 /d (gitt Volve oljepris på 18,7 USD/fat) nås er 11,4 MSm3
result.note: These are field and platform limits (PUD p.35 lists the same platform capacities); compare them with field totals, never one well. The maximum water cut is a share at full liquid rate: the water the platform can handle is liquid capacity x maximum water cut (water_sm3_per_day). The field reaching that share at a lower liquid rate means it ran at the design water cut, not over its water capacity. Rates are per calendar day of each month.
